description: iOS Portal client: every first-party module statically linked into the app (Waf --static-composition), SDL3 and the native Vulkan renderer over MoltenVK. Built on a Linux host with the pinned host toolchain below; signed and installed on a Mac.

intent.composition: static: no first-party shared library or module search path (AGENTS.md 'Platform-compliant composition')
intent.vulkan_implementation: MoltenVK (Vulkan portability subset over Metal), statically linked
intent.physics_provider: vphysics_box3d (Box3D) by default (user decision 2026-09-26; launcher_main/ios_main.cpp passes -physics vphysics_box3d); vphysics (IVP) is linked too
intent.support_scope: R29 groundwork. Not platform acceptance: no device, simulator or packaging evidence yet.
intent.packaging: .app assembled on Linux; codesign, provisioning and install (xcrun devicectl) on the Mac. Licensed Portal content is copied into the app's data container separately.
intent.deployment_target_reason: 17.0: devicectl installs, current SDL3 and MoltenVK (libMoltenVK.a minos 15.0) all support it; revisit before a store build.

ios.note: Info.plist is generated from these keys by build-ios-app.sh. UIFileSharingEnabled lets the Files app and devicectl place content in Documents. No privacy usage keys: the product requests no protected resource yet (microphone voice capture is unverified on device).

sdk.name: iPhoneOS.sdk
sdk.source: provided by the user, copied from Xcode on their Mac (xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path); never downloaded by the build
sdk.licence_note: Apple's Xcode licence covers use of the SDK on Apple-branded computers; placing it on the Linux build host is the user's decision (2026-09-25: 'building on the linux machine, and the signing + deploy on a mac').

llvm.signature_note: 2026-09-25: the release's OpenPGP signature verified against https://releases.llvm.org/release-keys.asc (EdDSA key FFB3368980F3E6BB5737145A316C56D064CACBA5); the sha256 is the pin.
llvm.note: clang compiles for arm64-apple-ios; ld64.lld performs the final app link. It does not implement -r, so module objects use Apple's ld64 below.

cctools_port.note: Apple's ld64 for 'ld64 -r' module objects, which turns hidden symbols local. Built without libtapi: it never reads the SDK's .tbd stubs.

libdispatch.note: libdispatch and BlocksRuntime, which ld64 requires.

moltenvk.note: Khronos's prebuilt release (sha256 equals the GitHub release asset digest). Building MoltenVK needs Xcode; libMoltenVK.a is built for iOS minos 15.0, SDK 26.5.

sdl3.note: Same pin as the Linux and Android profiles; built as a static library for iOS.

ktx_software.note: The archive, sha256 and CMake options are the Android profile's (one pin for the static KTX reader on both mobile targets).

vendored.source: thirdparty submodule (revision pinned by the superproject)
vendored.note: Cross-built as static libraries like the Android profile; zlib, bzip2 and iconv come from the SDK.

content.location: the app's data container (Documents), copied with xcrun devicectl on the Mac

required_checks: tools/ios/build_toolchain.py: pinned host toolchain and its ld64 -r / ld64.lld smoke test
tools/quality/static_composition.py check on the iOS tree: Mach-O module isolation, no first-party dylib, every module linked
startup on a device with no first-party dylib or module search path
foreground/background and surface recreation, touch and orientation, memory pressure (AGENTS.md iOS obligations)
separate simulator runs (additional, not a substitute for the device)

known_blockers: No iOS SDK on the build host yet: nothing has been compiled for iOS.
No Waf iOS target (DEST_OS ios), SDL3/freetype/png/jpeg/KTX iOS builds or .app assembly yet.
Legacy LightmappedGeneric and $phong need nine and seven descriptor sets; MoltenVK's limit must be queried (RFC 0007 grouped sets cover PBR only).
Phone GPUs lack BC textures: the material system decompresses DXT in software (memory cost unmeasured).
observations: 2026-09-25: the Linux static composition (same mechanism, ELF) boots testchmb_a_00 with no first-party shared library; see RFC/0001-static-composition-progress.md.
2026-09-25: ld64-956.6 -r on arm64-apple-ios objects turns hidden symbols local, including inline-function statics, and pulls private archive members; ld64.lld 22.1.8 rejects -r.

app_icon.note: The tvOS profile's key art; tools/ios/app_icons.py makes the square iOS icon from it.
